definition: Acute injury and emergency care, and death and dying. In crime, war, news or history, a killing, wound, cause of death or autopsy told only as part of the story is not health content (codebook section 3); these subtopics apply when the medical side (care, survival, disability, a medical explanation, or an autopsy finding of disease, overdose, poisoning, starvation or neglect) is itself described.
